# Donald Trump Approval Rating Slumps in 7 of 8 States Canada Targeted

Published

Sep 16, 2026 at 09:38 AM EDT

Sam Stevenson

Associate News Editor

President Donald Trump’s net approval rating has fallen in seven of eight states that Ontario Premier Doug Ford urged Canada to target with additional tariffs because of their political importance to the president’s base, according to Civiqs tracking. [...] Civiqs does not ask what caused each state’s movement, so the figures cannot prove that the trade fight drove the declines.

## What To Know

Civiqs’ rolling tracker of registered voters covers Trump’s second term from January 20, 2025 and includes 130,338 responses
results.title: Donald Trump Approval Rating Slumps in 7 of 8 States Canada Targeted

results.content:
Then there’s the economy. In Civiqs’ tracking, 75% of registered voters rated the national economy as good and just 18% as bad at this point in 2018. Today, that’s flipped: 33% good and 64% bad. There’s a night and day difference in voter perceptions of the economy now versus 2018.

Another question is: how easily can you blame the person in charge for the number one problem facing the country? In the voters’ minds, who’s holding the murder weapon?
results.title: The data driving Democratic optimism - by Patrick Ruffini

results.content:
Despite repeated offers of financial gain, Americans gave Trump poor ratings across several recent polls, reaching as high as a 61% disapproval rating in a Sept. 4-8 Economist/YouGov poll. In Michigan, a Sept. 9 Civiqs poll reported a 58% disapproval rating for Trump.

Real Clear Politics, which aggregates data from numerous polls, shows Trump's current average approval rating is 17.5 percentage points below his average disapproval rating — a similar trend from early September.
